verdict.rationale: Attio documents an official MCP server that lets Claude, ChatGPT or other AI tools search, update and manage the workspace. Its public REST API, with a published OpenAPI 3.1 spec, covers objects and records, so an agent can create and update records, and the product advertises automatic data enrichment. However, nothing shows that enrichment can be triggered through the API or MCP, or that an owner can be assigned programmatically. Lead enrichment and routing appear only as in-app workflow agents (Web Agent, Routing Agent), not as API or MCP operations. missing for 10: documented API/MCP owner-assignment, API/MCP-triggered company enrichment, end-to-end agent lead workflow example, independent hands-on corroboration.
